_comment: Drop into your project's .claude/settings.json via custos-init, which fills the hook command per install mode (local devDependency vs global). Manual wiring: set the command to `command -v custos-precheck-edit >/dev/null 2>&1 && custos-precheck-edit || true` (global install).

permissions._comment: Optional: prevent Claude from bypassing the pre-commit citation check. Humans can still --no-verify locally.
